description:
In the early Joseon Dynasty, Hong Chunki, a worker at the Baekyu Flower Group, catches a man who has fallen from the sky on the night of the winter solstice. Looking at the handsome looking man as if he were not of this world, Hong Chunki remembers the words of his mother who prayed for her single daughter to have a good marriage and believes he is her heaven given man.

Haram, a man who was blinded after being involved in an unknown accident while attending a festival as a child. After meeting Hong Chunki, he discovers the secret around her eyes.

[Original Web Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=6314473)
